t: This is the home of the Varkey Foundation, a nonprofit organisation in the United Kingdom. It began life as the Varkey GEMS Foundation and was formed in 2010. It's the nonprofit arm of GEMS Education, an education management company. The name comes from Sunny Varkey, the Indian businessman who formed it. He's an education entrepreneur and philanthropist based in Dubai, and founder and executive chairman of GEMS Education, the world's largest operator of private schools from kindergarten to grade twelve.
